svg.title: Concentration risk: many processes, one model
svg.desc: Two panels. Left: four business processes all call one model from one provider; an outage, a change, or a flaw in that model hits all four at once. Right: the same processes call a gateway that routes to a primary model and fails over to a tested fallback from another provider, with contract terms that give notice of changes and an exit plan.
svg.text: Concentration risk: many processes, one model

g.text: Concentrated: every process calls one model
All four fail at the same time
